verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents strict typing, typed state schemas, or schema validation that would let a coding agent catch its own mistakes at build time. The only related item is the graph compile step's "basic checks on the structure of your graph (no orphaned nodes, etc)". That is a structural sanity check, an adjacent feature rather than type or schema validation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time
